page.content:
Matt Furie comic character later reused, and politicized, as an image macro.

How Pepe the Frog connects

  • Character: Matt Furie — Matt Furie created Pepe the Frog in Boy's Club.
  • Work: Boy's Club — Pepe first appeared in the comic Boy's Club.
  • Topic: Image macro — Pepe was reused as an image macro far beyond the comic.
  • Location: 4chan — Pepe's early meme life circulated on 4chan boards.
  • Character: Matt Furie — Furie later tried to reclaim or retire Pepe after political reuse he did not authorize.

What is Pepe the Frog?

Pepe began in Furie's Boy's Club as a laid-back frog. Boards and later political factions reused the drawing; this entry tracks that circulation as cultural history, not an endorsement of any later use.

Key threads lead to Matt Furie, Boy's Club, Image macro, 4chan and Matt Furie.
